variants.label: Split
variants.tooltip: A container that has two children and can be oriented in either a horizontal or vertical position with a draggable split bar that separates and resizes the two accordingly.

variants.label: Horizontal
variants.tooltip: A container that has two children and can be oriented in either a horizontal or vertical position with a draggable split bar that separates and resizes the two accordingly.

variants.label: Vertical
variants.tooltip: A container that has two children and can be oriented in either a horizontal or vertical position with a draggable split bar that separates and resizes the two accordingly.

orientation.description: The orientation in which the container's split is fixed. Horizontal will allow the user to adjust the container from left to right, while Vertical will allow the user to adjust it from top to bottom.

position.description: Bidirectionally represents the position of the split bar. Numeric values written here will be used as pixels.

size.description: The size of the split bar in pixels.

visible.description: Determines if the split bar should be visible.

draggable.description: Determines if the split bar should be draggable.

events.name: onMinBoundReached
events.description: This event is fired when the minimum bound on the container is reached by the handle

events.name: onMaxBoundReached
events.description: This event is fired when the maximum bound on the container is reached by the handle
